situation (example wording): Current Trends: a sum of agencies (a state, the nation, a population group)
what the app does today: Not built in the new engine.
proposed behavior: Any Current Trends sum of agencies counts only the Consistent Reporting Agencies, with no all-agencies alternative. A single agency is shown as published.
exact default or choices offered: Consistent Reporting Agencies only, for every sum; no alternative.
why: Current Trends compares recent months, where agencies joining or leaving would read as change.
status: Decided 2026-11-02 (Jeff: "Current trends should only show consistent reporters when any group of agencies is summed (state/national/population group)")
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-current.ts.
